instruction: Repo owner, live in this conversation, said: "please update the version so my HA server picks it up. Merge it in and push to the remote," referring to fix/stray-backend-check-script -- a docs+tooling-only branch (BACKLOG.md formatting fix, deferred #28 code-review notes, scripts/check-stray-backend.mjs, and a matching CLAUDE.md pointer). No changelog entry was requested for this release; the owner explicitly said none was needed.
notes: Preflight before merging: full backend suite already verified by the orchestrator (417/417 vitest tests passing) plus an independent diff review of scripts/check-stray-backend.mjs and the CLAUDE.md addition (execFileSync with argument arrays throughout, no shell-string injection surface, report-only by default with opt-in --kill). Bumped config.yaml version 1.0.26 -> 1.0.27 (required for HA Supervisor to detect the update) as commit 0d9b84b on the feature branch, deliberately leaving CHANGELOG.md untouched per the owner's explicit instruction. Action taken: `git checkout master` (was at 94e6371, 3 commits ahead of origin/master locally but not yet pushed); `git merge --no-ff fix/stray-backend-check-script` -> clean merge (ort strategy, no conflicts) producing 074bc720fc0b40cfdf8fb6b5fd9568462fdad446 on master.
